prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was telling my coworker about that short trip to Hangzhou back in 2025—honestly the whole thing was pretty smooth.
We ended up staying at this place called West Lake State Guesthouse; I still remember the name because it sounded so official.
Zhang Wei was the one whose name the stay was under, and it was check-in on 2025-03-12 for 2 nights—already done and dusted.
Then the next week we were chatting about Shanghai too—someone brought up attractions there and how packed everything felt.
Oh, and my friend Li Na had already booked Yu Garden for us—morning slot on 2025-03-22, and it was 4 tickets total.
That day was 2025-03-22 and the ticket count was 4, and later we were just chatting about restaurants in Shanghai—plus we took an economy ride back to the hotel anyway.
